Move an item under another, or to the top of the tree with --root

## Usage

```text
chainmail item move <id> (<parent-id> | --root) [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail item move it_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8a9 it_admin_work
# back to the inbox
chainmail item move it_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8a9 --root
```

## Flags

```text
      --root   move the item to the top of the tree; a task goes to the inbox
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
